title: The control block and the slots
body: struct mpsc_ring: the slot array, the capacity and its mask (read-only after creation), who owns the storage and where it began, then the producers' enqueue_pos (_Atomic uint64_t) and the consumer's dequeue_pos (plain uint64_t), each aligned on its own cache line, the separation proven by a _Static_assert; mpsc_slot_t: an _Atomic uint64_t sequence and the void* payload.
rationale: One place holds what the producers and the consumer share; the per-slot sequence is the only state they both write.

title: Storage and placement
body: mpsc_ring_storage_size() (the control block, the worst-case slack of both alignments, the slots) and mpsc_ring_init_into(): the control block aligned up inside the caller's storage, the lock-free probe of enqueue_pos, the slots aligned after the block, the probe of a slot's sequence, every slot's sequence set to its index.
rationale: The caller's memory at any alignment; nothing allocated on this path.

title: Owned storage and teardown
body: mpsc_ring_init(): calloc of exactly mpsc_ring_storage_size() bytes, mpsc_ring_init_into() over them, the ownership recorded, the bytes freed on any failure; mpsc_ring_destroy(): the storage freed only when owned, the caller's pointer cleared.
rationale: One control for both modes: the owned path is the caller-owned one over the library's own block.

title: The producers' claim and publish
body: mpsc_ring_push(): enqueue_pos read relaxed; the slot's sequence read with acquire; equal to pos: a weak compare-and-swap of enqueue_pos claims the position; behind: the ring is full; ahead: another producer moved on, enqueue_pos is read again; after the claim the payload is stored and the sequence released at pos + 1.
rationale: Many producers, one shared position, a distinct slot each.

title: The consumer's take
body: mpsc_ring_pop() and mpsc_ring_is_empty(): the consumer's plain dequeue_pos, the slot's sequence read with acquire, published when equal to pos + 1; pop reads the payload, advances dequeue_pos and releases the sequence at pos + capacity, freeing the slot for the next lap.
rationale: One consumer: no compare-and-swap on its side.

title: The capacity
body: mpsc_ring_capacity(): the fixed size, 0 for NULL, from any thread.
rationale: The one query that needs no side.

title: The test seams (tests only)
body: Under MPSC_RING_TESTING only: the allocator replaced, the two lock-free verdicts overridden, a single-shot hook fired between push's snapshot of enqueue_pos and its claim, and mpsc_ring_test_steal_enqueue_pos() moving the position without publishing, so that a single-threaded test reaches the lost-claim branch; without the switch none of it is compiled or exported.
rationale: Every branch covered deterministically, including the one only real contention reaches.
